Bengaluru's Waste Management Crisis Deepens

The city of Bengaluru is facing a growing waste management crisis, with residents and local authorities proposing alternative solutions. The West City Corporation has announced plans to crack down on bulk waste generators, while some RWAs are pitching source composting and smarter waste solutions. This story highlights the need for effective waste management in India's rapidly growing cities.
